title: 第478章 别动，让我来
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“斯斯！”

蛰伏在地的青纹岩蜥缓缓起身。

身上附着的碎石泥土簌簌脱落，露出它的本来面目。

灰褐鳞皮遍布青蓝色纹路，四肢利爪轻轻一划就将身下的岩石撕裂。

那一双独属于冷血生物的竖瞳，此刻正牢牢锁定林奇所在的方位，满是猎食者的暴戾与杀意。

“小风铃，你在一旁掠阵。”

林奇嘱咐了一句，直接弹跳而出，率先发动进攻。

“嘶嘶~”

月光之下，光影交错间。

巨大的青纹岩蜥弹射跃起。

转瞬间跳出几十米，快速逼近林奇。

血盆大口已经将林奇笼罩，只要合拢便能将其吞掉。

“好快的速度！”

林奇瞳孔骤缩。

他知道青纹岩蜥速度快，可也没想到这家伙的速度这么快！

“骸骨之王！”

“轰！”

一团黑焰快速升起，巨大的骷髅出现，将林奇牢牢包裹住。

下一秒，青纹岩蜥的血盆大口，直接咬在骸骨之王的地狱王铠上，发出刺耳的摩擦声。

“吼！”

骸骨之王怒吼一声，骷髅巨掌抓住青纹岩蜥的头颅，狠狠向着地面摔去。

两座庞然大物重重摔落在地，地面剧烈震颤，硬生生砸出一个凹陷的深坑。

剧烈的震荡传遍全身，身处骸骨之王内部的林奇，也是被震得头晕目眩。

“咳咳…”

他环顾四周，满脸错愕。

“我这是在骸骨之王体内？”

外界战场，

骸骨之王已经爬了起来，骷髅头颅中的金色魂火充满战意。

拳头如雨点落下，接连砸在青纹岩蜥的脑袋上。

“嘶…”

青纹岩蜥发出痛苦的嘶鸣。

骸骨之王的王者意志相当于精神层面的攻击，青纹岩蜥被短暂的削弱了战斗意志，还处于懵逼状态。

它不明白，刚刚还是一个鲜美的人类，怎么突然间就变成了难啃的骷髅了？

骸骨之王体内，林奇也是十分不好受。

他和骸骨之王的融合，并不是能屈指必使的那种融合。

而是单纯的被困在骸骨之王的骷髅铠甲之内了。

骸骨之王每攻击一下，他都跟着摇摇晃晃的，五脏六腑都在震动。

“不行，我得出去。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Sisi!"

The dormant blue-patterned rock lizard slowly got up.

The gravel and soil attached to the body fell off, revealing its true appearance.

The gray-brown scales are covered with green and blue lines, and the sharp claws of its limbs can tear the rock underneath it apart with a single stroke.

The pair of vertical pupils that belong exclusively to cold-blooded creatures were firmly locked on Lynch's position at this moment, filled with the violence and murderous intent of a predator.

"Little wind chime, you are rushing aside."

Lin Qi gave instructions, jumped out directly, and took the lead in attacking.

"Hiss~"

Under the moonlight, light and shadow intersect.

The huge blue-striped rock lizard jumped up.

In an instant, he jumped dozens of meters away and quickly approached Lin Qi.

The bloody mouth has already enveloped Lynch, and he can be swallowed by just closing it.

"What a speed!"

Lin Qi's pupils shrank suddenly.

He knew that the Blue Striped Rock Lizard was fast, but he didn't expect this guy to be so fast!

"King of Bones!"

"Boom!"

A ball of black flame rose quickly, and a huge skeleton appeared, wrapping Lynch tightly.

The next second, the blue-striped rock lizard's bloody mouth bit directly on the Hell King's armor of the Skeleton King, making a harsh friction sound.

"Roar!"

The King of Skeletons roared angrily, grabbed the blue-patterned rock lizard's head with his giant skeleton palm, and threw it hard towards the ground.

The two behemoths fell heavily to the ground, the ground shook violently, and a deep pit was created.

Violent shocks spread throughout his body, and Lin Qi, who was inside the King of Skeletons, was also shaken to the point of dizziness.

"Ahem..."

He looked around with astonishment on his face.

"Am I in the body of the King of Bones?"

The external battlefield,

The King of Skeletons has climbed up, and the golden soul fire in the skull is full of fighting spirit.

Fists fell like raindrops, hitting the blue-striped rock lizard's head one after another.

"Hiss..."

The blue-striped rock lizard roared in pain.

The King's Will of the Skeleton King was equivalent to a spiritual attack. The Blue Striped Rock Lizard was temporarily weakened in its will to fight and was still in a dazed state.

It doesn't understand why it was a delicious human being just now and suddenly turned into a skeleton that is difficult to chew.

Lin Qi also felt very uncomfortable inside the King of Bones.

The fusion between him and the King of Bones is not the kind of fusion that can be done at the slightest moment.

Instead, he was simply trapped within the skeleton armor of the King of Skeletons.

Every time the King of Skeletons attacked, he swayed, and his internal organs were shaking.

"No, I have to get out."
